blocks.etymology: From the substantivization of the above adjective through the associated taxon's name (Vertebrata) (see -ate (noun-forming suffix) for more).

senses.definition: an animal that has a spine or backbone

examples.en: Mammals and reptiles belong to the group of vertebrates.
examples.vi: Động vật có vú và bò sát thuộc nhóm động vật có xương sống.

thesaurus.definition: animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium

wiktionary.gloss: An animal having a backbone: one belonging to the subphylum Vertebrata.
